candidates.trace: The core InvestigationActionKind is the nine-variant canonical method owner with stable_id and FromStr. The selected capability issuer accepts that typed kind and stores its stable text at the native boundary. The backend view parses capability.method as InvestigationActionKind before including a row, but then exposes the stored method String. The simulation consumes that public row, sorts actions using generated_action_score, and generated_method_skill_fit matches raw text literals to initial profile insight/stealth scores before selecting its action. The selected current view suppresses rows whose method cannot parse, and no observed unknown method, changed outcome or runtime failure is claimed. The SDK/storage codec is an actual boundary; private ranking is a subsequent semantic consumer of the existing owner.

Other direct callers and source scope are not exhaustively established.
